By fusing real-time gravimetric plant-soil mass loss with NASA POWER, SMAP, and OpenET satellite telemetry via the FAO-56 Penman-Monteith model, TerraPulse downscales coarse 9 km orbital pixels into milliliter-exact irrigation prescriptions—cutting farm water waste by 40% on Earth and enabling closed-loop water tracking in Lunar habitats.
details: OVERVIEW: WHAT TERRAPULSE DOES TerraPulse is an orbital-to-edge Evapotranspiration (ET) calibration system developed by Team Velobotix. It turns an affordable load cell and microcontroller into a sub-gram micro-lysimeter that ground-truths NASA satellite data for milliliter-exact irrigation dosing. Agriculture consumes 70% of global freshwater, yet 40% is wasted due to blind dosing. Low-cost soil probes (₹150–₹200) only read a 1 cm radius of local permittivity, suffer from fertilizer salt and thermal drift, and show vague percentage alerts ("42% moisture") instead of exact water volume needed. Meanwhile, NASA SMAP and OpenET have coarse 30 m to 9 km pixels that mix farms, trees, and roads, suffer from monsoon cloud blindspots, and rely on research lysimeters costing ₹3L–₹15L. TerraPulse bridges this gap for under ₹1,200. HOW IT WORKS: 4-STAGE ORBITAL-TO-EDGE PIPELINE Weighing the plant-soil block converts mass loss directly into water volume (1 g = 1 mL): 1. Edge Gravimetric Sensing: A 1–5 kg load cell + 24-bit HX711 ADC logs continuous mass changes (Δm). Kalman and moving-average filters strip wind noise, while a night auto-tare algorithm isolates plant biomass growth. 2. Orbital NASA API Ingest: A Python engine pulls solar flux (SW_DWN), ambient temp (T2M), relative humidity (RH2M), and wind speed (WS2M) from NASA POWER, fused with NASA SMAP & OpenET. 3. Dynamic Kc Solve: Computes FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference ET (ET0) and locks the local Crop Coefficient (Kc = ETa / ET0), calibrating 5–10 acres per edge node. 4. Actionable mL Dosing: SSD1306 OLED & Flask UI output next-day mL irrigation doses adjusted for 90% drip efficiency (e.g., 142 mL lost -> dose 165 mL at 36°C tomorrow). TECH STACK & HARDWARE (< ₹1,200 BOM) - Hardware: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi (DT Pin 4, SCK Pin 5), HX711 24-Bit ADC, 1–5 kg load cell, SSD1306 OLED. - Software: C/C++ (Arduino firmware & DSP math), Python (Flask backend), Firebase Realtime DB, HTML/CSS/JS, Chart.js. - Space Agency Data: NASA POWER API, NASA SMAP, NASA OpenET. IMPACT & CREATIVITY - 99% Cheaper: Under ₹1,200 BOM vs. ₹5 Lakh commercial lysimeters. - 40% Water Saved: Downscales 9 km pixels to 1 m farm accuracy. - Dual-Use: Empowers smallholder farms on Earth today and tracks closed-loop water mass in Lunar/Martian Artemis greenhouse habitats. SI / AI ACKNOWLEDGMENT Generative AI / Super Intelligence (SI) tools were utilized to assist with web dashboard UI/UX code scaffolding, pitch deck concept illustrations, and documentation structuring. All core hardware architecture, Kalman DSP logic, and FAO-56 hydrology formulas were engineered and verified by Team Velobotix.
